unique_count_scope: Set union of the three registered shuffled40000-window prefixes; A/B share each prefix. Repeated use across arms/seeds is not an independent sample.

cost.includes: All10 allocations for each pair: loading/cache/forward-backward/validation/checkpoint/allocated overhead.
cost.excludes: Shared acceptance and historical engineering failures, all other budgets/suites, development/final rollouts and O2A are outside this training-only subset; they remain in the project ledger.
cost.warning: Paired jobs run both arms and share cache; these bills cannot be copied onto each arm, nor establish causal per-arm speed or wall-clock ETA.

checks: Original final reports equal training_summary arms and deployment receipts; all three root/independent/actual-selected-SHA gates passed.

All six40000 training_order files match private seeded full-pool shuffle; actual unique/per-task uses, shared A/B initialization/order and differing seeds verified.
All30 immutable pair-job snapshots match their SHA-bound pull raw sacct and accounting records; each allocation counted once.
